name: Tactec Meridian 6-Pocket Cargo Pant
description:
Straight-cut tactical pants in matte graphite or olive drab ripstop, with six external cargo pockets and four concealed interior ones. The fabric has a subtle grid texture from reinforced stress-point stitching. Sits mid-rise with a gusseted crotch for full range of motion.

Popular with security contractors, warehouse shift leads, and anyone who needs to carry a lot without looking like they're trying. Unassuming enough for a day job, practical enough for whatever happens after.
functionality: Six exterior cargo pockets, four concealed interior pockets, gusseted crotch, reinforced belt loops rated for duty belt weight
what_it_says: You're prepared, practical, and not interested in impressing anyone — just getting the job done.
story_hooks: A courier finds a sealed data chip tucked inside a pocket seam of a secondhand pair — it wasn't theirs.
A security guard's hidden pocket holds something their employer explicitly told them not to carry on shift.
